name: MaskWipeText
description: Multi-line headline where a colored bar sweeps across each line, then the line slides out from behind its mask (up/down) or is wiped open with a clip-path (left/right), staggered line by line with GSAP-style eases.
a11yNotes: All lines are exposed once as a single visually hidden sentence; the animated lines and wipe bars are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the lines render settled and the bars are not drawn. The rAF timeline is cancelled on unmount and replays on remount.

propsApi.name: lines
propsApi.default: ['Design in motion,', 'built to be felt,', 'not just seen.']
propsApi.description: Headline lines, each wiped in from behind its own mask.

propsApi.name: direction
propsApi.description: Direction the text travels as it is revealed.

propsApi.name: showBar
propsApi.description: Show a colored bar that sweeps across each line before the text appears.

propsApi.name: wipeColor
propsApi.description: Color of the sweeping wipe bar.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Duration of each line's reveal in seconds.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay between consecutive lines in seconds.

propsApi.name: delay
propsApi.description: Delay before the first line starts, in seconds.

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Text color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element (CSS variables included).
